Factory</span></p><p><span style=\"color: #ffffff;\">Factory Introduction</span></p><p><span style=\"color: #ffffff;\">Factory &middot; The Foundation of Quality Specializing in plastic pill boxes, Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province, Pingyang County Jinting Crafts Factory is a source manufacturer dedicated to the R&amp;D, production and sales of plastic pill boxes, pill cutters, retainer cases, baking storage boxes, phone cases and other products. The company operates a 3,000-square-meter modern plant equipped with core machinery including injection molding machines and blister pressing machines, with a daily production capacity of 20,000 units and an annual output exceeding 7 million units, plus a year-round inventory of over 100,000 units &mdash; providing stable supply assurance for bulk orders. The factory operates 3 or more complete production lines, exercising full in-house control over the entire process from melting, color matching, mold closing, filling, holding pressure and cooling to mold opening and demolding, as well as assembly, printing and packing &mdash; demonstrating strong capabilities in deep mold development, quality control and order fulfillment. With a daily capacity of 20,000 units, annual output exceeding 7 million units, and a year-round inventory of over 100,000 units, the factory provides a solid guarantee for high-volume production and stable supply. Whether for domestic e-commerce sales events or cross-border stocking, we ensure fast delivery and products that stand the test of the market. In addition, the factory holds the registered (&reg;) brand trademark &quot;金婷工艺 JINTINGGONGYI&quot; and can provide formal brand authorization to partners, supporting branded operations.</span></p><p><span style=\"color: #ffffff;\">Areas of Expertise &middot; Diverse Product Lines</span></p><p><span style=\"color: #ffffff;\">200+ SKUs in stock, worry-free dropshipping across all channels</span></p><p><span style=\"color: #ffffff;\">We focus on the R&amp;D and production of plastic pill boxes, pill cutters, retainer cases, baking storage boxes, phone cases and related products, committed to providing safe, comfortable and cost-effective storage and organizer products for households around the world. In terms of stock availability, we offer over 200+ in-stock SKUs with a wide variety &mdash; for example, our best-selling &quot;21/28-compartment storage boxes&quot; come in 20 size/spec options. We fully support one-piece dropshipping and full-managed/agency model labeling services across domestic platforms (1688, Taobao/Tmall, Douyin, Pinduoduo, etc.) and cross-border platforms (Amazon, TEMU, SHEIN, SHOPEE, Alibaba International, Etsy, TIKTOK, WILDBERRIES, WALMART, etc.). In terms of materials and craftsmanship, our raw materials are food-grade, high-clarity virgin PP &mdash; never recycled or regrind material &mdash; committed to providing households worldwide with all-round safe, comfortable and cost-effective pill box products. We launch 20+ new models every year, consistently leading market trends.</span></p><p><span style=\"color: #ffffff;\">R&amp;D Leadership &middot; Trend Insight</span></p><p><span style=\"color: #ffffff;\">Independent design team, seizing traffic opportunities ahead of the curve</span></p><p><span style=\"color: #ffffff;\">We understand that pill box products are a trend-driven category, so we have built an independent design and R&amp;D team that conducts monthly in-depth analysis of domestic and international pill box fashion trends, planning new product development 3 months in advance. Mold development fees are quoted by customer service, and mold development takes only 35 days, helping products hit the market quickly. Customization processes are diverse, supporting water plating, pad printing, UV printing, screen printing, heat transfer printing and more. Custom sampling costs 300 RMB per sample, and the full sampling fee is refundable for a single order of 1,000+ units of bulk goods, minimizing customer trial-and-error costs.
